name: The Cathedral School of Chartres
summary: Under Bernard of Chartres, Thierry of Chartres, William of Conches, and Bishop Gilbert de la Porrée, the cathedral school at Chartres becomes the leading centre of 12th-century Latin Platonist philosophy and study of natural causes. Its alumni and texts shape the early universities of Paris and Oxford.

_quarry.structural_significance: Transmits a synthesised reading of Plato's Timaeus, Boethius, Augustine, and newly-translated Aristotle to the next generation of scholastics. The phrase 'dwarfs standing on the shoulders of giants' is attributed to Bernard of Chartres.
